original_prompt:
Administrator AI

আমি  Worker-এর আউটপুট পেয়েছি।

Workflow অনুযায়ী আমার কাজ এখানে শেষ। Administrator হিসেবে আমি Final AI-এর আউটপুটে নিজে কোনো পরিবর্তন করছি না।

The weight you carry becomes the shape of your arms.
Nobody drowns from the water alone; they drown from forgetting to move.
You don't find courage. You spend it, and it grows back thicker.
Regret is memory with nowhere left to go.
The door was never locked. You just kept knocking out of habit.
Some scars are just skin remembering it survived.
A river doesn't ask the stone to change. It simply keeps arriving.
You are not behind. The road just never asked your permission to be long.
Quiet rooms have taught more people to fight than loud ones ever did.
The version of you that quits is easier to become, but harder to live with.
